decisions.summary: archive.load's manifest rows (a json.load per small file, 0.06 s, R4) not kept: 'per file, but cheaper than keeping'
decisions.why: FR-001 literally reaches a per-file parse. But the request's mechanism rests on keeping being much cheaper than extracting; for these same files (the archive manifest rows, in R3's partial-citations trial) keeping per file was measured to cost what reading does (0.33 s against 0.32 s, labeled), and the MEMO's fact is keyed by the text, so the file is read either way and only a json.loads of a small row would be saved out of 0.06 s. Applying the rule delivers none of the stated purpose (speed). No regex is applied (json), so the GM's literal example does not reach it.
